summary: Frontend-only responsiveness test of the homepage and /shop. Supabase was mocked in the browser only: maintenance turned off, 8 fake catalog products, and testimonials body lines. No data was written. Widths tested: 390, 768, 1024, 1279, 1280, 1366, 1440, 1535, 1536, 1600 and 1920. PASS: (1) No horizontal page overflow anywhere: scrollWidth == clientWidth at every width on / and /shop, and no element pokes past the viewport. (2) All 6 product rails (bestsellers, new_arrivals, offer, trending, festive, tabs) use display:flex with overflow-x:auto below 1024px. Cards are 165px at 390 and 216px at 768, and rails really scroll (scrollLeft 353/236). At 1024px and above they are a 4-column grid with overflow visible. (3) Testimonials are a flex rail at 390/768 (scrollWidth 945/1090) and a 3-column grid at 1024+. (4) category-scroll-row scrolls sideways at all widths, and category-next-btn at 1366 moves it from scrollLeft 0 to 264. (5) The hamburger shows below 1024 and is hidden at 1024+. Nav shows 4 links at 1024-1279, 6 at 1280-1535 and 7 at 1536+, always on one line. (6) Hero h1 is 36/48/60/72px at 390/768/1024/1280+ and stays inside the viewport. Mobile hero uses object-position 72% so the model shows. (7) The quick-add bar has opacity 1 at 390/768 and opacity 0 at 1024+, turning to 1 on hover. On mobile only the discount badge shows, and the New/Anti-tarnish chips are hidden as intended. 0 page errors. FAIL: 2 layout defects, listed below.

ui_bugs.issue: At viewport >= 1536px (checked at 1536, 1600 and 1920) the 7th link 'Festive' runs into the centred logo. At 1536 the nav's right edge is x=682, its grid column ends at x=662 and the logo starts at x=678, so the nav overflows its 1fr cell by about 20px and 'Festive' touches the 'I' of 'Iminationz'. This happens because container-x caps at max-w-7xl (1200px of content), so the left column never grows past about 494px. 7 links at 14px with gap-x-6 need about 514px. Fix: keep 6 links at 2xl too, cut the gap to gap-x-4 or the font to 13px at 2xl, or widen the header container (e.g. max-w-screen-2xl for the header only).

category-prev-btn and category-next-btn use 'hidden md:flex', so they appear at tablet width (768px), not only on desktop as the spec says. At 768 the left arrow sits over the first category tile, and the right arrow is in the same bottom-right area as the WhatsApp and back-to-top floating buttons. Change it to 'hidden lg:flex'.

issues: The live homepage_content now has rows for marquee (sort 102), features (104) and tabs (108), so they render at the very bottom after the newsletter, not after hero/categories/new_arrivals. The owner probably expects these near the top, so fix their sort_order values. This is a data/ordering issue, not a responsive one.
With discount + New + Anti-tarnish all set, 3 stacked chips cover about 40% of the image height on 216px cards. This is acceptable, but consider showing at most 2 chips below lg.

action_items: Layout.js header nav: stop the 7-link nav overflowing into the logo at >= 1536px (reduce the gap/font at 2xl, drop to 6 links, or widen the header container).
Home.js Categories: change the arrow buttons from 'hidden md:flex' to 'hidden lg:flex' so they only appear on desktop.
critical_code_review_comments: The nav breakpoint logic assumes the left grid column grows with the viewport, but container-x caps the width at 1280px. Every width >= 1536 gets the same roughly 494px column.
Home.js withNewSections only adds keys that are missing. Rows that already exist with a high sort_order (marquee/features/tabs) render at the end.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% (2 layout defects out of 8 checked requirements)

seed_data_creation: None. All data was mocked with Playwright page.route (store_settings maintenance disabled, catalog with 8 fake products, homepage_content testimonials body).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Mock store_settings (set maintenance.value.enabled=false), catalog (8 products, give the content-range header) and homepage_content (testimonials body 'Name | quote'). Set localStorage imz_consent='denied' via add_init_script. Re-check the header at 1536/1920 (nav-festive right edge < header-logo left edge) and confirm category arrows are hidden at 768.
